import asyncio
import sys
from fastmcp import Server
from mcp.client.session import ClientSession
from mcp.client.stdio import StdioClient


async def main():
    backend_command = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "python -m backend"
    
    proxy = Server("mcp-proxy")
    backend = ClientSession(StdioClient(backend_command))
    await backend.initialize()
    
    try:
        # Register all tools from backend
        tools_response = await backend.list_tools()
        for tool_info in tools_response.tools:
            def create_tool_handler(name):
                async def handler(**kwargs):
                    result = await backend.call_tool(name, kwargs)
                    return result.content[0].text if result.content else ""
                return handler
            
            proxy.add_tool(
                name=tool_info.name,
                description=tool_info.description or "",
                input_schema=tool_info.inputSchema,
                handler=create_tool_handler(tool_info.name)
            )
        
        # Register all resources from backend
        resources_response = await backend.list_resources()
        for resource_info in resources_response.resources:
            def create_resource_handler(uri):
                async def handler():
                    result = await backend.read_resource(uri)
                    return result.contents[0].text if result.contents else ""
                return handler
            
            proxy.add_resource(
                uri=resource_info.uri,
                name=resource_info.name or "",
                description=resource_info.description or "",
                mime_type=getattr(resource_info, "mimeType", "text/plain"),
                handler=create_resource_handler(resource_info.uri)
            )
        
        # Run proxy server
        async with proxy.run_stdio():
            await asyncio.sleep(float('inf'))
    
    finally:
        await backend.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
